card.name: Qualifiers before condition names
card.fires_on: Qualifier words that start a medical condition name, such as chronic, primary, or the end of Malignant, in headings and indication lists. Also a period after an editor list in a reference citation.

modes.label: Qualifier before condition
modes.description: Chronic, primary, or malignant right before the condition they modify, often in a heading or list of indications.
modes.example: 2.3 Management of Pain,<< Primary>> Dysmenorrhea, and Acute

modes.label: End of Malignant
modes.description: The final piece of the word Malignant in headings before neoplasms or melanoma.

modes.label: Citation period
modes.description: Period after the editors list in a textbook reference.
modes.example: Brandt LJ, eds<<.>> Sleisenger and Fordtran's G

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next word being a condition or health term, but the output effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on words like chronic, primary or malignant that come just before a disease name.
